description: This file defines UI components and formatting logic for displaying nodes in a menu UI, including text formatting, icons, and views for representing node information in a macOS application using SwiftUI.

classes.name: NodeMenuEntryFormatter
classes.description: A utility struct providing static methods to format, categorize, and display information about NodeInfo objects, including text labels, icons, and version info.

classes.name: NodeMenuRowView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a row in the nodes menu, displaying node icons, names, statuses, and additional info.

classes.name: AndroidMark
classes.description: A custom SwiftUI view rendering an icon indicating an Android device.

classes.name: NodeMenuMultilineView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for multiline display of node attributes, such as labels and values.

methods.name: isGateway
methods.description: Determines if a NodeInfo represents a gateway node based on its nodeId.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if a NodeInfo indicates a connected node.

methods.name: primaryName
methods.description: Returns the primary display name for a node, prioritizing displayName or defaulting to 'Gateway' or nodeId.

methods.name: summaryText
methods.description: Generates a summary string describing the node, including hostname, role, platform, version, and status.

methods.name: roleText
methods.description: Returns a string describing the connection state of the node, such as 'connected' or 'disconnected'.

methods.name: detailLeft
methods.description: Provides a brief detail string, such as IP address and role.

methods.name: platformText
methods.description: Returns a formatted platform string such as 'macOS' based on node properties.

methods.name: compactVersion
methods.description: Trims and simplifies version strings, removing parenthetical suffixes.

methods.name: shortVersionLabel
methods.description: Returns a shortened version label, adding a 'v' prefix if needed.

methods.name: versionLabels
methods.description: Generates core and UI version labels for a node, with optional compact formatting.

methods.name: resolveVersions
methods.description: Resolves core and UI version information, falling back to legacy version if necessary.

methods.name: isHeadlessPlatform
methods.description: Determines if a platform string indicates a headless system like Darwin, Linux, or Windows.

methods.name: leadingSymbol
methods.description: Returns the appropriate system symbol name based on node type or device family.

methods.name: isAndroid
methods.description: Checks if the node device family or platform indicates an Android device.

methods.name: safeSystemSymbol
methods.description: Returns the preferred system symbol if available; otherwise, falls back to an alternative.
